title: Strawberry mascarpone tart
description: Nigel Slater's no-bake strawberry tart is exceptionally simple to make, with a biscuit base that can survive a hot kitchen.

steps.text: To make the crumb case, melt the butter in a small saucepan. Place the biscuits in a food processor and process to fine crumbs (alternatively, place in a plastic bag and bash with a rolling pin, taking care not to split the bag).
steps.raw: To make the crumb case, melt the butter in a small saucepan. Place the biscuits in a food processor and process to fine crumbs (alternatively, place in a plastic bag and bash with a rolling pin, taking care not to split the bag).

steps.text: Mix the crumbs thoroughly with the melted butter and spoon into a 25cm/10in diameter loose-bottomed flan tin. Press the crumbs firmly over the base and up the sides of the tin to cover completely. Transfer to the fridge to chill until firm.
steps.raw: Mix the crumbs thoroughly with the melted butter and spoon into a 25cm/10in diameter loose-bottomed flan tin. Press the crumbs firmly over the base and up the sides of the tin to cover completely. Transfer to the fridge to chill until firm.

steps.text: To make the filling, put the egg yolk into a bowl with the caster sugar and beat for a few seconds until thoroughly mixed.
steps.raw: To make the filling, put the egg yolk into a bowl with the caster sugar and beat for a few seconds until thoroughly mixed.

steps.text: Add the mascarpone and beat until thoroughly combined. Stir in the vanilla extract.
steps.raw: Add the mascarpone and beat until thoroughly combined. Stir in the vanilla extract.

steps.text: In a separate bowl, beat the egg white with a clean whisk until stiff peaks form when the whisk is removed from the bowl. Gently fold the egg white into the mascarpone mixture.
steps.raw: In a separate bowl, beat the egg white with a clean whisk until stiff peaks form when the whisk is removed from the bowl. Gently fold the egg white into the mascarpone mixture.

steps.text: Remove the biscuit crumb case from the fridge. Spoon the mascarpone mixture into the case and gently smooth the top with a spatula. Arrange the sliced strawberries on top of the mascarpone.
steps.raw: Remove the biscuit crumb case from the fridge. Spoon the mascarpone mixture into the case and gently smooth the top with a spatula. Arrange the sliced strawberries on top of the mascarpone.

steps.text: Transfer to the fridge and chill. Remove the tart from the fridge 20 minutes before serving.
steps.raw: Transfer to the fridge and chill. Remove the tart from the fridge 20 minutes before serving.

chefTips: You can easily make this with gluten-free biscuits for a gluten-free strawberry tart.
